newsitem.title: INDIA: India allows reverse repos for non-bank entities.
newsitem.headline: India allows reverse repos for non-bank entities.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Tuesday said non-bank entities would be allowed to enter reverse repo trades with banks and primary dealers.

"It has been decided to allow non-bank entities who are holders of SGL accounts with the RBI to enter into reverse repo transactions with banks or primary dealers in treasury bills of all maturities and all dated central government securities," RBI said in its monetary policy statement.
RBI said non-bank entities would not be allowed to enter into repo transactions with banks and primary dealers.
The central bank said all transactions would have to be effected in Bombay.
